figurative_meaning_en: Despicable; ugly; grotesque or bizarre in appearance
similar_in_english: Face only a mother could love
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চেহারা উটকোমুখো, কেউ দেখলেই ভয় পায়।
এই উটকোমুখো ছবিটা দেখলে মনে হয় কোনো দানব এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His face is camel-mouthed, anyone who sees it gets scared.
Looking at this camel-mouthed picture, it seems like a monster has arrived.
note: This idiom is used as a strong insult in colloquial Bengali, emphasizing extreme ugliness.
